name: Shibori
desc: Indigo shibori resist-dyeing where bound, folded and clamped cloth yields white spider-bursts, storm streaks or clamped grids on deep indigo, the dye perpetually oxidizing and pooling in slow drifting waves with soft bled edges.

style.doc: technique: spider-burst / storm streaks / clamped mirror grid / stitched gathers / bleach-discharge on black
